relations.rationale: Knowing there are two teams sets the context but doesn't determine whether Ana and Ben are on different teams.
Knowing there are two teams doesn't determine whether Ben and Cy are on different teams.
Knowing there are two teams doesn't determine whether Ana and Cy are on different teams.

If Ana and Ben are on different teams, with only two teams total, Ben and Cy being on different teams would put Cy with Ana, which is independent of this direct claim about Ben and Cy; but with two teams, if Ana and Ben differ, and Ben and Cy also differ, Cy must equal Ana's team, which is logically consistent but not forced by A alone.
Ana and Ben being on different teams doesn't by itself determine whether Ana and Cy are on different teams.
